critical_code_review_comments: article/[id].tsx:185 uses marginTop: insets.top + 72 which correctly pushes the video below the fixed absolute topBar (44px icon at y=0 + padding). Verified y=72 on web preview where insets.top==0. iOS/Android with non-zero insets.top will simply add more headroom, which is safe.
(tabs)/_layout.tsx:37 sets tabBarShowLabel:false — clean way to enforce icon-only nav; Tabs.Screen still uses title:'Home' etc for a11y/screen-reader announcement, which is fine.
article/[id].tsx:212-224 conditional 'Video' vs 'X min read' meta row is well scoped by post.type !== 'video' — works for any future video content too.

rca_of_issue: N/A — all 3 reported bugs are fully fixed. Root cause of original bugs (before this iter's fix): (a) video article used no top offset so YouTube iframe rendered at y=0 under the absolute topBar; fixed by marginTop: insets.top + 72. (b) tabBarShowLabel defaulted true; fixed by explicit false. (c) meta row unconditionally rendered `${reading_time} min read`; fixed by post.type==='video' branch showing 'Video' + play-circle icon.
